name: Plymouth Sloe Gin
base_ingredient: Plymouth Gin with steeped sloe berries
production: Sloes steeped in Plymouth Gin for about four months
history: 1793 | Gin production begins at Black Friars Distillery (Fox & Williamson)
1883 | Date of the sloe gin recipe used today
2008 | Pernod Ricard acquires Plymouth Gin via V&S Group
notes: Retailer suggests neat, over ice, Sloe Gin Fizz or Sloe Royale. Owner page lists Pernod Ricard ownership since 2008 (via The Absolut Group).
